title: sorbus austriaca subsp. hazslinszkyana
intro: Sorbus austriaca subsp. hazslinszkyana, commonly known as Hazslinszky's mountain ash, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family. It is an evergreen shrub native to the mountainous regions of Central Europe. The health benefits of Hazslinszky's mountain ash include its potential in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
